hints.title: Filtering Year 2020 Sessions
hints.text: Filter login timestamps occurring strictly within calendar year 2020.

hints.title: Grouping by User Identifier
hints.text: Group records by user_id and compute the maximum timestamp.

hints.title: Projecting Results with Required Column Name
hints.text: Rename the aggregated maximum timestamp to last_stamp in the output table.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT
    user_id,
    MAX(time_stamp) AS last_stamp
FROM Logins
WHERE time_stamp >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND time_stamp < '2021-01-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY user_id;
```

complexity.time: O(N) single pass or O(U) with index on (time_stamp, user_id)
complexity.space: O(U) hash table for distinct users
complexity.notes: Grouped aggregation with half-open timestamp range filtering.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: YEAR(time_stamp) = 2020 prevents using standard b-tree indexes on time_stamp.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Half-open range predicate enables index range scan.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should prefer sargable date bounds and use MAX aggregate.
